g.text: The same number of hot-dry days can form very different runs
Orange: Tmax >= 35 C and rain < 1 mm/day; gray: condition absent, not missing. All selected cells have complete records.
First two rows maximize the run-length contrast among cells with the same event-day count. The global maximum run is included.
